_note: Interest credited on an employee's balance in a recognised provident fund, in so far as it is allowed at a rate above the notified rate, is deemed received and is salary (D-151; rulebook PF-RPF12-001). The rate: S.O. 1046(E), 13-5-2011, Notification No. 24/2011, under 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(b), "with effect from the 1st day of September, 2010, 9.5 per cent.", superseding S.O. 2091(E) — read in two third-party copies that agree, the ClearTax mirror of the Department's PDF (sources/2026-09-28-perquisite-thresholds.md Y1) and Manupatra's, accepted as verified by the owner (D-182). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(b) (thc.nic.in p.856), "interest credited on the balance to the credit of the employee in so far as it is allowed at a rate exceeding such rate as may be fixed by the Central Government", charged by s.17(1)(vi). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 Sch. XI Pt A para 6 as substituted by the Finance Act, 2026 s.127(a)(iii) from 1-4-2026, "interest credited on the balance to the credit of an employee in so far as it is allowed at a rate exceeding such rate as fixed by the Central Government by notification" (Gazette 271439, p.71), charged by s.17(1)(i) (Gazette 265620, p.38); the 2011 notification carried by s.536(2)(j). The portion above the rate is the interest less the notified rate on the balance it was allowed on: the node hands in INTEREST (credited) and BALANCE (interest ÷ the rate allowed), per employment. Every employee. Every regime.
